reasoning: The icon depicts a half-filled Wi-Fi wedge with a padlock badge, universally recognized from Android status bars as a secured wireless network. Although originally a signal-strength state icon, in a task list it works well for tasks about Wi-Fi passwords, guest network logins, and router security, though it closely overlaps with a full-strength secured Wi-Fi icon.
